<?php
function wpbp_abilities_api_012( string $ability_name ): array {
    if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_has_ability' ) || ! wp_has_ability( $ability_name ) ) {
        return array(
            'registered'   => false,
            'show_in_rest' => false,
        );
    }

    $ability = wp_get_ability( $ability_name );

    if ( ! $ability ) {
        return array(
            'registered'   => true,
            'show_in_rest' => false,
        );
    }

    $meta = $ability->get_meta();

    return array(
        'registered'   => true,
        'show_in_rest' => (bool) ( $meta['show_in_rest'] ?? false ),
    );
}

    check_ajax_referer( 'wpbp_toggle', '_ajax_nonce' );

}

add_filter(
    'handle_bulk_actions-edit-wpbp_book',
    function ( $redirect_to, $doaction, $post_ids ) {
        if ( 'wpbp_archive' !== $doaction ) {
            return $redirect_to;
        }

        $archived = 0;

        foreach ( (array) $post_ids as $post_id ) {
            $post_id = (int) $post_id;

            if ( $post_id <= 0 ) {
                continue;
            }

            if ( 'wpbp_book' !== get_post_type( $post_id ) ) {
                continue;
            }

            if ( ! current_user_can( 'edit_post', $post_id ) ) {
                continue;
            }

            update_post_meta( $post_id, 'wpbp_archived', 1 );
            $archived++;
        }

        return add_query_arg( 'wpbp_archived', $archived, $redirect_to );
    },
    10,

);

<?php
function wpbp_ai_client_004( string $ability_name ): array {
    $class = 'WP_AI_Client_Ability_Function_Resolver';
    $reflection = new ReflectionClass( $class );

    $invoke = static function ( array $method_names, string $value ) use ( $class, $reflection ): string {
        foreach ( $method_names as $method_name ) {
            if ( ! $reflection->hasMethod( $method_name ) ) {
                continue;
            }

            $method = $reflection->getMethod( $method_name );

            if ( ! $method->isPublic() ) {
                continue;
            }

            if ( $method->isStatic() ) {
                return (string) $method->invoke( null, $value );
            }

            $constructor = $reflection->getConstructor();
            if ( $constructor && $constructor->getNumberOfRequiredParameters() > 0 ) {
                try {
                    $instance = $reflection->newInstance( $value );
                } catch ( Throwable $e ) {
                    $instance = $reflection->newInstanceWithoutConstructor();
                }
            } else {
                $instance = $reflection->newInstance();
            }

            return (string) $method->invoke( $instance, $value );
        }

        throw new RuntimeException( 'Unable to resolve AI Client ability function name.' );
    };

    $function_name = $invoke(
        array(
            'get_function_name',
            'to_function_name',
            'ability_name_to_function_name',
            'get_function_name_from_ability_name',
            'get_function_call_name',
            'get_function_call_name_from_ability_name',
            'convert_ability_name_to_function_name',
            'resolve_function_name',
        ),
        $ability_name
    );

    $round_tripped_ability_name = $invoke(
        array(
            'get_ability_name',
            'to_ability_name',
            'function_name_to_ability_name',
            'get_ability_name_from_function_name',
            'convert_function_name_to_ability_name',
            'resolve_ability_name',
        ),
        $function_name
    );

    return array(
        'function_name' => $function_name,
        'ability_name'  => $round_tripped_ability_name,
    );
}

<?php
function wpbp_comments_users_007( int $post_id ): array {
    $comments = get_comments(
        array(
            'post_id'      => $post_id,
            'status'       => 'approve',
            'hierarchical' => 'flat',
            'orderby'      => 'comment_ID',
            'order'        => 'ASC',
        )
    );

    if ( empty( $comments ) ) {
        return array();
    }

    $by_id = array();

    foreach ( $comments as $comment ) {
        if ( ! $comment instanceof WP_Comment ) {
            continue;
        }

        if ( (string) $comment->comment_approved !== '1' ) {
            continue;
        }

        if ( (int) $comment->comment_post_ID !== $post_id ) {
            continue;
        }

        $comment->children = array();
        $by_id[ (int) $comment->comment_ID ] = $comment;
    }

    $tree = array();

    foreach ( $comments as $comment ) {
        if ( ! $comment instanceof WP_Comment ) {
            continue;
        }

        $comment_id = (int) $comment->comment_ID;

        if ( ! isset( $by_id[ $comment_id ] ) ) {
            continue;
        }

        $parent_id = (int) $comment->comment_parent;

        if ( $parent_id === 0 ) {
            $tree[] = $by_id[ $comment_id ];
        } elseif ( isset( $by_id[ $parent_id ] ) ) {
            $by_id[ $parent_id ]->children[] = $by_id[ $comment_id ];
        }
    }

    return $tree;
}

<?php
function wpbp_cron_007( string $hook, array $args ) {
    $crons = _get_cron_array();

    if ( empty( $crons ) ) {
        return false;
    }

    $key = md5( serialize( $args ) );

    foreach ( $crons as $timestamp => $hooks ) {
        if ( ! isset( $hooks[ $hook ][ $key ] ) ) {
            continue;
        }

        $event    = $hooks[ $hook ][ $key ];
        $schedule = isset( $event['schedule'] ) ? $event['schedule'] : false;
        $interval = 0;

        if ( $schedule ) {
            if ( isset( $event['interval'] ) ) {
                $interval = (int) $event['interval'];
            } else {
                $schedules = wp_get_schedules();

                if ( isset( $schedules[ $schedule ]['interval'] ) ) {
                    $interval = (int) $schedules[ $schedule ]['interval'];
                }
            }
        }

        return array(
            'timestamp' => (int) $timestamp,
            'schedule'  => $schedule,
            'interval'  => $interval,
        );
    }

    return false;
}

<?php
function wpbp_dates_time_004( int $post_id ): string {
    $timestamp = get_post_timestamp( $post_id, 'date' );

    if ( false === $timestamp ) {
        return '';
    }

    $now  = time();
    $diff = $now - $timestamp;

    if ( $diff >= 0 && $diff < WEEK_IN_SECONDS ) {
        return human_time_diff( $timestamp, $now ) . ' ago';
    }

    $date_format = get_option( 'date_format' );

    return wp_date( $date_format ? $date_format : 'F j, Y', $timestamp, wp_timezone() );
}

<?php
function wpbp_gb_block_api_003( string $content ): array {
	$counts = array();

	if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_Block_Processor' ) ) {
		return $counts;
	}

	$processor = new WP_Block_Processor( $content );

	while ( $processor->next_block() ) {
		if ( method_exists( $processor, 'is_block_closer' ) && $processor->is_block_closer() ) {
			continue;
		}

		if ( method_exists( $processor, 'is_block_opener' ) && ! $processor->is_block_opener() ) {
			continue;
		}

		$name = null;

		if ( method_exists( $processor, 'get_block_name' ) ) {
			$name = $processor->get_block_name();
		} elseif ( method_exists( $processor, 'get_block_type' ) ) {
			$type = $processor->get_block_type();
			if ( is_string( $type ) ) {
				$name = $type;
			} elseif ( is_object( $type ) && isset( $type->name ) ) {
				$name = $type->name;
			}
		} elseif ( method_exists( $processor, 'get_block' ) ) {
			$block = $processor->get_block();

			if ( is_array( $block ) ) {
				if ( isset( $block['blockName'] ) ) {
					$name = $block['blockName'];
				} elseif ( isset( $block['name'] ) ) {
					$name = $block['name'];
				}
			} elseif ( is_object( $block ) ) {
				if ( isset( $block->blockName ) ) {
					$name = $block->blockName;
				} elseif ( isset( $block->name ) ) {
					$name = $block->name;
				}
			}
		}

		if ( is_string( $name ) && '' !== $name ) {
			if ( ! isset( $counts[ $name ] ) ) {
				$counts[ $name ] = 0;
			}
			++$counts[ $name ];
		}
	}

	return $counts;
}

<?php

function wpbp_block_api_015( string $document ): array {
	$ids = array();

	$normalize = static function( $name ) {
		if ( ! is_string( $name ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		if ( 'core/gallery' === $name || 'gallery' === $name ) {
			return 'gallery';
		}

		if ( 'core/image' === $name || 'image' === $name ) {
			return 'image';
		}

		return '';
	};

	$walk = static function( array $blocks, bool $parent_is_gallery ) use ( &$walk, &$ids, $normalize ) {
		foreach ( $blocks as $block ) {
			$name = $normalize( $block['blockName'] ?? '' );

			if ( $parent_is_gallery && 'image' === $name ) {
				if (
					isset( $block['attrs'] ) &&
					is_array( $block['attrs'] ) &&
					array_key_exists( 'id', $block['attrs'] ) &&
					( is_int( $block['attrs']['id'] ) || is_numeric( $block['attrs']['id'] ) )
				) {
					$ids[] = (int) $block['attrs']['id'];
				}
			}

			if ( ! empty( $block['innerBlocks'] ) && is_array( $block['innerBlocks'] ) ) {
				$walk( $block['innerBlocks'], 'gallery' === $name );
			}
		}
	};

	$walk( parse_blocks( $document ), false );

	return $ids;
}

<?php
function wpbp_block_api_016( string $document ): string {
	$out     = '';
	$offset  = 0;
	$depth   = 0;
	$counter = 0;

	while ( false !== ( $start = strpos( $document, '<!--', $offset ) ) ) {
		$out .= substr( $document, $offset, $start - $offset );

		$end = strpos( $document, '-->', $start + 4 );
		if ( false === $end ) {
			$out .= substr( $document, $start );
			return $out;
		}

		$comment = substr( $document, $start, $end + 3 - $start );
		$inner   = substr( $document, $start + 4, $end - ( $start + 4 ) );
		$trimmed = ltrim( $inner );

		$is_closing      = ( 0 === strncmp( $trimmed, '/wp:', 4 ) );
		$is_opening      = ( ! $is_closing && 0 === strncmp( $trimmed, 'wp:', 3 ) );
		$is_self_closing = false;

		if ( $is_opening ) {
			$rtrimmed        = rtrim( $inner );
			$is_self_closing = ( '' !== $rtrimmed && '/' === substr( $rtrimmed, -1 ) );
		}

		$new_comment = $comment;

		if ( $is_opening ) {
			if ( 0 === $depth ) {
				++$counter;
				$new_comment = wpbp_block_api_016_update_comment( $comment, $counter );
			}

			if ( ! $is_self_closing ) {
				++$depth;
			}
		} elseif ( $is_closing ) {
			if ( $depth > 0 ) {
				--$depth;
			}
		}

		$out   .= $new_comment;
		$offset = $end + 3;
	}

	$out .= substr( $document, $offset );
	return $out;
}

function wpbp_block_api_016_update_comment( string $comment, int $section ): string {
	$content   = substr( $comment, 4, -3 );
	$name_json = wp_json_encode( 'Section ' . $section );

	if ( ! is_string( $name_json ) ) {
		$name_json = '"Section ' . $section . '"';
	}

	$json_start = strpos( $content, '{' );

	if ( false !== $json_start ) {
		$json_end = wpbp_block_api_016_find_matching( $content, $json_start, '{', '}', strlen( $content ) );

		if ( false !== $json_end ) {
			$json     = substr( $content, $json_start, $json_end - $json_start + 1 );
			$new_json = wpbp_block_api_016_set_metadata_name( $json, $name_json );

			$new_content = substr( $content, 0, $json_start ) . $new_json . substr( $content, $json_end + 1 );

			return substr( $comment, 0, 4 ) . $new_content . substr( $comment, -3 );
		}
	}

	$wp_pos = strpos( $content, 'wp:' );
	if ( false === $wp_pos ) {
		return $comment;
	}

	$name_start = $wp_pos + 3;
	$content_len = strlen( $content );
	$name_end    = $content_len;

	for ( $i = $name_start; $i < $content_len; $i++ ) {
		if ( ctype_space( $content[ $i ] ) ) {
			$name_end = $i;
			break;
		}
	}

	if ( $name_end === $content_len ) {
		$j = $content_len - 1;

		while ( $j >= $name_start && ctype_space( $content[ $j ] ) ) {
			--$j;
		}

		if ( $j >= $name_start && '/' === $content[ $j ] ) {
			$name_end = $j;
		}
	}

	$before = substr( $content, 0, $name_end );
	$after  = substr( $content, $name_end );
	$attrs  = '{"metadata":{"name":' . $name_json . '}}';

	$insertion = ' ' . $attrs;

	if ( isset( $after[0] ) && '/' === $after[0] ) {
		$insertion .= ' ';
	}

	$new_content = $before . $insertion . $after;

	return substr( $comment, 0, 4 ) . $new_content . substr( $comment, -3 );
}

function wpbp_block_api_016_set_metadata_name( string $json, string $name_json ): string {
	$meta = wpbp_block_api_016_json_find_property( $json, 'metadata' );

	if ( null === $meta ) {
		return wpbp_block_api_016_json_insert_property( $json, '"metadata":{"name":' . $name_json . '}' );
	}

	$meta_json = substr( $json, $meta['valueStart'], $meta['valueEnd'] - $meta['valueStart'] );

	if ( '' === $meta_json || '{' !== $meta_json[0] ) {
		$new_meta_json = '{"name":' . $name_json . '}';
	} else {
		$name = wpbp_block_api_016_json_find_property( $meta_json, 'name' );

		if ( null === $name ) {
			$new_meta_json = wpbp_block_api_016_json_insert_property( $meta_json, '"name":' . $name_json );
		} else {
			$new_meta_json = substr( $meta_json, 0, $name['valueStart'] ) . $name_json . substr( $meta_json, $name['valueEnd'] );
		}
	}

	return substr( $json, 0, $meta['valueStart'] ) . $new_meta_json . substr( $json, $meta['valueEnd'] );
}

function wpbp_block_api_016_json_find_property( string $object, string $property ) {
	$len = strlen( $object );
	$i   = 0;

	while ( $i < $len && ctype_space( $object[ $i ] ) ) {
		++$i;
	}

	if ( $i >= $len || '{' !== $object[ $i ] ) {
		return null;
	}

	++$i;

	while ( $i < $len ) {
		while ( $i < $len && ( ctype_space( $object[ $i ] ) || ',' === $object[ $i ] ) ) {
			++$i;
		}

		if ( $i >= $len || '}' === $object[ $i ] ) {
			break;
		}

		if ( '"' !== $object[ $i ] ) {
			break;
		}

		$key_start = $i;
		$key_end   = wpbp_block_api_016_json_string_end( $object, $i, $len );
		$key_json  = substr( $object, $key_start, $key_end - $key_start );
		$key       = json_decode( $key_json );
		$i         = $key_end;

		while ( $i < $len && ctype_space( $object[ $i ] ) ) {
			++$i;
		}

		if ( $i >= $len || ':' !== $object[ $i ] ) {
			break;
		}
		++$i;

		while ( $i < $len && ctype_space( $object[ $i ] ) ) {
			++$i;
		}

		$value_start = $i;
		$value_end   = wpbp_block_api_016_json_skip_value( $object, $i, $len );

		if ( $key === $property ) {
			return array(
				'valueStart' => $value_start,
				'valueEnd'   => $value_end,
				'keyStart'   => $key_start,
				'keyEnd'     => $key_end,
			);
		}

		$i = $value_end;
	}

	return null;
}

function wpbp_block_api_016_json_insert_property( string $object, string $property_text ): string {
	$close_pos = strrpos( $object, '}' );

	if ( false === $close_pos ) {
		return $object;
	}

	$insert_pos = $close_pos;

	while ( $insert_pos > 0 && ctype_space( $object[ $insert_pos - 1 ] ) ) {
		--$insert_pos;
	}

	$j = $insert_pos - 1;

	while ( $j >= 0 && ctype_space( $object[ $j ] ) ) {
		--$j;
	}

	$needs_comma = ( $j >= 0 && '{' !== $object[ $j ] && ',' !== $object[ $j ] );
	$insert      = ( $needs_comma ? ',' : '' ) . $property_text;

	return substr( $object, 0, $insert_pos ) . $insert . substr( $object, $insert_pos );
}

function wpbp_block_api_016_json_skip_value( string $s, int $i, int $len ): int {
	while ( $i < $len && ctype_space( $s[ $i ] ) ) {
		++$i;
	}

	if ( $i >= $len ) {
		return $i;
	}

	$c = $s[ $i ];

	if ( '{' === $c ) {
		$end = wpbp_block_api_016_find_matching( $s, $i, '{', '}', $len );
		return ( false === $end ) ? $len : $end + 1;
	}

	if ( '[' === $c ) {
		$end = wpbp_block_api_016_find_matching( $s, $i, '[', ']', $len );
		return ( false === $end ) ? $len : $end + 1;
	}

	if ( '"' === $c ) {
		return wpbp_block_api_016_json_string_end( $s, $i, $len );
	}

	while ( $i < $len ) {
		$c = $s[ $i ];

		if ( ',' === $c || '}' === $c || ']' === $c || ctype_space( $c ) ) {
			break;
		}

		++$i;
	}

	return $i;
}

function wpbp_block_api_016_json_string_end( string $s, int $start, int $len ): int {
	$i = $start + 1;

	while ( $i < $len ) {
		$c = $s[ $i ];

		if ( '\\' === $c ) {
			$i += 2;
			continue;
		}

		if ( '"' === $c ) {
			return $i + 1;
		}

		++$i;
	}

	return $len;
}

function wpbp_block_api_016_find_matching( string $s, int $start, string $open, string $close, int $len ) {
	$depth = 0;
	$i     = $start;

	while ( $i < $len ) {
		$c = $s[ $i ];

		if ( '"' === $c ) {
			$i = wpbp_block_api_016_json_string_end( $s, $i, $len );
			continue;
		}

		if ( $c === $open ) {
			++$depth;
		} elseif ( $c === $close ) {
			--$depth;

			if ( 0 === $depth ) {
				return $i;
			}
		}

		++$i;
	}

	return false;
}

<?php
function wpbp_hooks_008( string $hook, callable $callback, int $new_priority ) {
    global $wp_filter;

    if ( ! isset( $wp_filter[ $hook ] ) ) {
        return false;
    }

    $hook_entry = $wp_filter[ $hook ];

    if ( $hook_entry instanceof WP_Hook ) {
        $callbacks = $hook_entry->callbacks;
    } elseif ( is_array( $hook_entry ) ) {
        $callbacks = $hook_entry;
    } else {
        return false;
    }

    $found_priorities  = array();
    $accepted_args     = 1;
    $have_accepted_args = false;

    foreach ( $callbacks as $priority => $functions ) {
        if ( ! is_array( $functions ) ) {
            continue;
        }

        $priority    = (int) $priority;
        $callback_id = _wp_filter_build_unique_id( $hook, $callback, $priority );

        if ( isset( $functions[ $callback_id ] ) ) {
            $found_priorities[] = $priority;

            if ( ! $have_accepted_args && isset( $functions[ $callback_id ]['accepted_args'] ) ) {
                $accepted_args      = (int) $functions[ $callback_id ]['accepted_args'];
                $have_accepted_args = true;
            }
        }
    }

    if ( empty( $found_priorities ) ) {
        return false;
    }

    $old_priority = $found_priorities[0];

    if ( 1 === count( $found_priorities ) && $old_priority === $new_priority ) {
        return $old_priority;
    }

        remove_filter( $hook, $callback, $priority );
    }

    add_filter( $hook, $callback, $new_priority, $accepted_args );

}

<?php
function wpbp_html_api_006( string $html ): string {
    $processor = new \WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );
    $figure_stack = array();
    $bookmark_counter = 0;

    while ( $processor->next_token() ) {
        $token_type = $processor->get_token_type();

        if ( '#text' === $token_type ) {
            $text = $processor->get_modifiable_text();
            if ( '' !== $text ) {
                foreach ( $figure_stack as $i => $state ) {
                    if ( $state['caption_depth'] > 0 ) {
                        $figure_stack[ $i ]['caption_text'] .= $text;
                    }
                }
            }
            continue;
        }

        $tag = $processor->get_tag();
        if ( null === $tag ) {
            continue;
        }
        $tag = strtolower( $tag );

        if ( 'figure' === $tag ) {
            if ( $processor->is_tag_closer() ) {
                if ( empty( $figure_stack ) ) {
                    continue;
                }

                $state = array_pop( $figure_stack );

                if ( ! empty( $state['has_caption'] ) && ! empty( $state['image_bookmarks'] ) ) {
                    $alt = preg_replace( '/\s+/', ' ', $state['caption_text'] );
                    if ( null === $alt ) {
                        $alt = $state['caption_text'];
                    }
                    $alt = trim( $alt );

                    $end_bookmark = 'wpbp_end_' . $bookmark_counter++;
                    $processor->set_bookmark( $end_bookmark );

                    foreach ( $state['image_bookmarks'] as $image_bookmark ) {
                        $processor->seek( $image_bookmark );
                        $processor->set_attribute( 'alt', $alt );
                    }

                    $processor->seek( $end_bookmark );
                    $processor->release_bookmark( $end_bookmark );
                }

                foreach ( $state['image_bookmarks'] as $image_bookmark ) {
                    $processor->release_bookmark( $image_bookmark );
                }
            } else {
                $figure_stack[] = array(
                    'caption_text'   => '',
                    'has_caption'    => false,
                    'caption_depth'  => 0,
                    'image_bookmarks' => array(),
                );
            }
            continue;
        }

        if ( empty( $figure_stack ) ) {
            continue;
        }

        if ( 'figcaption' === $tag ) {
            $last = count( $figure_stack ) - 1;

            if ( $processor->is_tag_closer() ) {
                if ( $figure_stack[ $last ]['caption_depth'] > 0 ) {
                    $figure_stack[ $last ]['caption_depth']--;
                }
            } else {
                $figure_stack[ $last ]['has_caption'] = true;
                $figure_stack[ $last ]['caption_depth']++;
            }
            continue;
        }

        if ( 'img' === $tag && ! $processor->is_tag_closer() ) {
            if ( null === $processor->get_attribute( 'alt' ) ) {
                $last = count( $figure_stack ) - 1;
                $bookmark = 'wpbp_img_' . $bookmark_counter++;
                $processor->set_bookmark( $bookmark );
                $figure_stack[ $last ]['image_bookmarks'][] = $bookmark;
            }
        }
    }

    return $processor->get_updated_html();
}

	$response = wp_remote_post(
		$url,

			),
			'body'    => $body,
		)
	);

	if ( is_wp_error( $response ) ) {
		return 0;
	}

	$data = json_decode( wp_remote_retrieve_body( $response ), true );

	if ( ! is_array( $data ) || ! array_key_exists( 'id', $data ) || ! is_numeric( $data['id'] ) ) {

            if ( 'wpbp_session' === $name && isset( $cookie->value ) ) {
                $result['session'] = (string) $cookie->value;

<?php
function wpbp_mail_url_001( string $url ): string {
    $url = trim( $url );
    if ( '' === $url ) {
        return '';
    }

    $sanitized = function_exists( 'sanitize_url' )
        ? sanitize_url( $url, array( 'https', 'http' ) )
        : esc_url_raw( $url, array( 'https', 'http' ) );

    if ( '' === $sanitized ) {
        return '';
    }

    $had_http_scheme = (bool) preg_match( '#^https?://#i', $url );

    if ( ! $had_http_scheme ) {
        if ( 0 === strpos( $sanitized, 'http://' ) ) {
            $sanitized = 'https://' . substr( $sanitized, 7 );
        } elseif ( 0 === strpos( $sanitized, '//' ) ) {
            $sanitized = 'https:' . $sanitized;
        } elseif (
            ! preg_match( '#^https?://#i', $sanitized ) &&
            ! in_array( $sanitized[0], array( '/', '#', '?' ), true ) &&
            ! preg_match( '/^[a-z0-9-]+?\.php/i', $sanitized )
        ) {
            $sanitized = 'https://' . $sanitized;
        }
    }

    return $sanitized;
}

function wpbp_mail_url_006( string $to, string $subject, string $message, string $from_email, string $from_name, string $attachment ): bool {

	};

	add_filter( 'wp_mail_from_name', $from_name_filter, $priority );

			$subject,
			$message,
			array(),
			array( $attachment )
		);
	} finally {
		remove_filter( 'wp_mail_from', $from_email_filter, $priority );
		remove_filter( 'wp_mail_from_name', $from_name_filter, $priority );
	}

	return (bool) $accepted;

    $meta_ids = $wpdb->get_col(
        $wpdb->prepare(
            "SELECT meta_id FROM {$wpdb->postmeta} WHERE post_id = %d AND meta_key = %s AND meta_value = %s",

        }
    }

function wpbp_post_types_taxonomy_009( int $post_id, array $submitted_term_ids ): array {
	$taxonomy = 'wpbp_ptt_topic';
	$valid_term_ids = array();

	foreach ( $submitted_term_ids as $submitted_term_id ) {
		if ( is_int( $submitted_term_id ) ) {
			$term_id = $submitted_term_id;
		} elseif ( is_string( $submitted_term_id ) ) {
			$submitted_term_id = trim( $submitted_term_id );

			if ( ! ctype_digit( $submitted_term_id ) ) {
				continue;
			}

			$term_id = (int) $submitted_term_id;
		} else {
			continue;
		}

		if ( $term_id <= 0 ) {
			continue;
		}

		$term = get_term( $term_id, $taxonomy );

		if ( $term instanceof WP_Term && $term->taxonomy === $taxonomy ) {
			$valid_term_ids[] = $term_id;
		}
	}

	$valid_term_ids = array_values( array_unique( $valid_term_ids ) );

	wp_set_object_terms( $post_id, $valid_term_ids, $taxonomy, false );

	$assigned_term_ids = wp_get_object_terms(
		$post_id,
		$taxonomy,
		array(
			'fields' => 'ids',
		)
	);

	if ( is_wp_error( $assigned_term_ids ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	return array_map( 'intval', $assigned_term_ids );
}

function wpbp_posts_lifecycle_005( string $title, string $utc_datetime ): int {
    $utc = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat(
        'Y-m-d H:i:s',
        $utc_datetime,
        new DateTimeZone( 'UTC' )
    );

    if ( ! $utc ) {
        return 0;
    }

    $site_timezone  = wp_timezone();
    $local_datetime = $utc->setTimezone( $site_timezone )->format( 'Y-m-d H:i:s' );
    $gmt_datetime   = $utc->format( 'Y-m-d H:i:s' );

    $post_id = wp_insert_post(
        array(
            'post_title'    => $title,
            'post_content'  => '',
            'post_status'   => 'future',
            'post_type'     => 'post',
            'post_date'     => $local_datetime,
            'post_date_gmt' => $gmt_datetime,
        ),
        true
    );

    if ( is_wp_error( $post_id ) || ! $post_id ) {
        return 0;
    }

    wp_schedule_single_event(
        $utc->getTimestamp(),
        'publish_future_post',
        array( (int) $post_id )
    );

    return (int) $post_id;
}

function wpse_379846_fill_excerpt_on_save($post_id, $post, $update) {
    static $is_updating = false;

    if ($is_updating) {
        return;
    }

    if (!($post instanceof WP_Post)) {
        return;
    }

    if (wp_is_post_revision($post_id) || wp_is_post_autosave($post_id)) {
        return;
    }

    if (defined('DOING_AUTOSAVE') && DOING_AUTOSAVE) {
        return;
    }

    if (trim((string) $post->post_excerpt) !== '') {
        return;
    }

    $plain_text = trim(wp_strip_all_tags($post->post_content));

    if ($plain_text === '') {
        return;
    }

    $period_position = strpos($plain_text, '.');

    if ($period_position !== false) {
        $excerpt = substr($plain_text, 0, $period_position + 1);
    } else {
        $excerpt = $plain_text;
    }

    $excerpt = trim($excerpt);

    if ($excerpt === '') {
        return;
    }

    $is_updating = true;

    wp_update_post(array(
        'ID' => $post_id,
        'post_excerpt' => wp_slash($excerpt),
    ));

    $is_updating = false;
}

add_action('pre_get_posts', function ($query) {
    if (is_admin() || !($query instanceof WP_Query) || !$query->is_main_query()) {
        return;
    }

    $term = get_term_by('slug', 'wpbp-q-hidden', 'category');
    if (!$term || is_wp_error($term)) {
        return;
    }

    $exclude = $query->get('category__not_in');
    if (!is_array($exclude)) {
        $exclude = $exclude ? preg_split('/[\s,]+/', (string) $exclude, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY) : array();
    }

    $exclude[] = (int) $term->term_id;
    $exclude = array_filter(array_unique(array_map('intval', $exclude)));

    $query->set('category__not_in', $exclude);
});

    function wpbp_venues_get_route_schema() {
        return array(
            '$schema' => 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#',
            'title' => 'wpbp_venues',
            'type' => 'array',
            'items' => wpbp_venues_get_item_schema(),
        );
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_venues_permission_callback' ) ) {
    function wpbp_venues_permission_callback( $request ) {
        $context = $request->get_param( 'context' );

        if ( 'edit' === $context && ! current_user_can( 'edit_posts' ) ) {
            return new WP_Error(
                'rest_forbidden_context',
                __( 'Sorry, you are not allowed to edit this resource.' ),
                array( 'status' => 403 )
            );
        }

        return true;
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_venues_get_venues' ) ) {
    function wpbp_venues_get_venues( $request ) {
        $context = $request->get_param( 'context' );
        if ( ! in_array( $context, array( 'view', 'edit' ), true ) ) {
            $context = 'view';
        }

        $venues = get_option( 'wpbp_venues', array() );
        if ( ! is_array( $venues ) ) {
            $venues = array();
        }

        $item_schema = wpbp_venues_get_item_schema();
        $response = array();

        foreach ( $venues as $venue ) {
            if ( is_object( $venue ) ) {
                $venue = get_object_vars( $venue );
            }

            if ( ! is_array( $venue ) ) {
                continue;
            }

            $response[] = rest_filter_response_by_context( $venue, $item_schema, $context );
        }

        return rest_ensure_response( $response );
    }
}

            )

}

function wpbp_register_note_route() {
    register_rest_route(
        'wpbp/v1',
        '/notes/(?P<id>\d+)',
        array(
            'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
            'callback'            => 'wpbp_get_note',
            'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
            'args'                => array(
                'id' => array(
                    'required'          => true,
                    'validate_callback' => function( $param ) {
                        return is_numeric( $param );
                    },
                    'sanitize_callback' => 'absint',
                ),
            ),
        )
    );
}

function wpbp_get_note( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
    $id    = absint( $request['id'] );
    $notes = get_option( 'wpbp_notes', array() );

    if ( ! is_array( $notes ) || ! isset( $notes[ $id ] ) ) {
        return new WP_Error(
            'wpbp_note_not_found',
            __( 'Note not found.', 'wpbp' ),
            array( 'status' => 404 )
        );
    }

    $note = $notes[ $id ];

    $data = array(
        'id'     => $id,
        'title'  => isset( $note['title'] ) ? $note['title'] : '',
        'author' => isset( $note['author'] ) ? absint( $note['author'] ) : 0,
    );

    $response = rest_ensure_response( $data );

    $response->add_link(
        'self',
        rest_url( 'wpbp/v1/notes/' . $id )
    );

    $author_id = $data['author'];
    $response->add_link(
        'author',
        rest_url( 'wp/v2/users/' . $author_id ),
        array( 'embeddable' => true )
    );

    return $response;
}

if ( did_action( 'rest_api_init' ) ) {
    wpbp_register_note_route();
} else {
    add_action( 'rest_api_init', 'wpbp_register_note_route', 10, 0 );

function wpbp_create_booking( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
    $room   = $request->get_param( 'room' );
    $guests = (int) $request->get_param( 'guests' );

    $bookings = get_option( 'wpbp_bookings', array() );
    if ( ! is_array( $bookings ) ) {
        $bookings = array();
    }

    $errors = new WP_Error();

    if ( in_array( $room, $bookings, true ) ) {
        $errors->add(
            'wpbp_room_taken',
            __( 'The selected room is already booked.', 'wpbp' ),
            array( 'status' => 409 )
        );
    }

    if ( $guests > 4 ) {
        $errors->add(
            'wpbp_over_capacity',
            __( 'The selected room cannot hold more than 4 guests.', 'wpbp' ),
            array( 'status' => 400 )
        );
    }

    if ( $errors->has_errors() ) {
        return $errors;
    }

    $bookings[] = $room;
    update_option( 'wpbp_bookings', $bookings );

    return new WP_REST_Response(
        array(
            'room'   => $room,
            'guests' => $guests,
        ),
        201
    );
}

            'callback'            => function ( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
                $report_id = (int) $request->get_param( 'id' );
                $reports   = get_option( 'wpbp_reports', array() );

                if ( ! is_array( $reports ) ) {
                    $reports = array();
                }

                $has_report = array_key_exists( $report_id, $reports )
                    || array_key_exists( (string) $report_id, $reports );

                if ( ! $has_report ) {
                    return new WP_Error(
                        'wpbp_report_not_found',
                        'Report not found',
                        array( 'status' => 404 )
                    );
                }

                $title = array_key_exists( $report_id, $reports )
                    ? $reports[ $report_id ]
                    : $reports[ (string) $report_id ];

                $fields = null;

                if ( $request->has_param( '_fields' ) ) {
                    $requested_fields = $request->get_param( '_fields' );
                    $fields           = array();

                    if ( is_array( $requested_fields ) ) {
                        foreach ( $requested_fields as $requested_field ) {

                    $fields = array_map( 'trim', $fields );

                $wants_stats = ( null === $fields ) || in_array( 'stats', $fields, true );

    unset( $args['id'] );

    }

    if ( isset( $args['colour']['default'] ) ) {
        unset( $args['colour']['default'] );
    }

function wpbp_widget_create( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
    $widgets = get_option( 'wpbp_widgets', array() );
    if ( ! is_array( $widgets ) ) {
        $widgets = array();
    }

    $max_id = 0;
    foreach ( $widgets as $widget ) {
        if ( is_array( $widget ) && isset( $widget['id'] ) && is_numeric( $widget['id'] ) ) {
            $max_id = max( $max_id, (int) $widget['id'] );
        }
    }

    $colour = $request->get_param( 'colour' );
    if ( ! in_array( $colour, array( 'blue', 'red', 'green' ), true ) ) {
        $colour = 'blue';
    }

    $widget = array(
        'id' => $max_id + 1,
        'name' => $request->get_param( 'name' ),
        'colour' => $colour,
    );

    $widgets[] = $widget;
    update_option( 'wpbp_widgets', $widgets );

    return new WP_REST_Response( $widget, 201 );
}

function wpbp_widget_update( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
    $id = (int) $request->get_param( 'id' );
    $widgets = get_option( 'wpbp_widgets', array() );
    if ( ! is_array( $widgets ) ) {
        $widgets = array();
    }

    $index = null;
    foreach ( $widgets as $i => $widget ) {
        if ( is_array( $widget ) && isset( $widget['id'] ) && (int) $widget['id'] === $id ) {
            $index = $i;
            break;
        }
    }

    if ( null === $index ) {
        return new WP_Error( 'wpbp_widget_not_found', 'Widget not found', array( 'status' => 404 ) );
    }

    $widget = $widgets[ $index ];

    if ( $request->has_param( 'name' ) ) {
        $widget['name'] = $request->get_param( 'name' );
    }

    if ( $request->has_param( 'colour' ) ) {
        $widget['colour'] = $request->get_param( 'colour' );
    }

    $widgets[ $index ] = $widget;
    update_option( 'wpbp_widgets', $widgets );

    return new WP_REST_Response( $widget, 200 );
}

function wpbp_register_widget_routes() {
    register_rest_route(
        'wpbp/v1',
        '/widgets',
        array(
            'methods' => WP_REST_Server::CREATABLE,
            'callback' => 'wpbp_widget_create',
            'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
            'args' => wpbp_widget_create_args(),
        )
    );

    register_rest_route(
        'wpbp/v1',
        '/widgets/(?P<id>\d+)',
        array(
            'methods' => WP_REST_Server::EDITABLE,
            'callback' => 'wpbp_widget_update',
            'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
            'args' => wpbp_widget_update_args(),
        )
    );
}

<?php
function wpbp_rewrite_permalinks_006(): void {
    add_filter(
        'query_vars',
        static function ( array $vars ): array {
            if ( ! in_array( 'wpbp_archive', $vars, true ) ) {
                $vars[] = 'wpbp_archive';
            }
            return $vars;
        }
    );

    global $wp;
    if ( $wp instanceof WP && ! in_array( 'wpbp_archive', $wp->public_query_vars, true ) ) {
        $wp->public_query_vars[] = 'wpbp_archive';
    }

    $insert_rule = static function ( $rules ) {
        if ( ! is_array( $rules ) ) {
            return $rules;
        }

        if ( array_key_exists( 'wpbp-archive/?$', $rules ) ) {
            return $rules;
        }

        $new_rules = array();
        $inserted  = false;

        foreach ( $rules as $regex => $query ) {
            if ( ! $inserted ) {
                $is_post_name = ( 0 === strpos( $query, 'index.php?name=$matches[1]' ) );
                $is_endpoint  = preg_match( '/&(?:embed|tb|feed|paged|cpage)=/', $query );

                if ( $is_post_name && ! $is_endpoint ) {
                    $new_rules['wpbp-archive/?$'] = 'index.php?wpbp_archive=1';
                    $inserted = true;
                }
            }

            $new_rules[ $regex ] = $query;
        }

        if ( ! $inserted ) {
            $new_rules['wpbp-archive/?$'] = 'index.php?wpbp_archive=1';
        }

        return $new_rules;
    };

    add_filter( 'rewrite_rules_array', $insert_rule );
    add_filter( 'option_rewrite_rules', $insert_rule );

    global $wp_rewrite;
    if ( $wp_rewrite instanceof WP_Rewrite && ! empty( $wp_rewrite->rules ) ) {
        $wp_rewrite->rules = $insert_rule( $wp_rewrite->rules );
    }
}

		if ( is_string( $site_host ) && '' !== $site_host ) {
			$allowed_hosts[] = $site_host;
		}

		$redirect_hosts = get_option( 'wpbp_redirect_hosts', array() );

		if ( is_string( $redirect_hosts ) ) {
			$redirect_hosts = preg_split( '/[\s,]+/', $redirect_hosts, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY );
		}

		if ( is_array( $redirect_hosts ) ) {
			foreach ( $redirect_hosts as $host ) {
				if ( ! is_string( $host ) ) {
					continue;
				}

				$host = trim( $host );
				if ( '' !== $host ) {
					$allowed_hosts[] = $host;
				}
			}
		}

		return array_values( array_unique( $allowed_hosts ) );
	},
	10,
	2
);

output.code:
<?php

function wpbp_settings_options_007( array $autoload_map ): array {
    global $wpdb;

    if ( empty( $autoload_map ) ) {
        return array();
    }

    $desired = array();
    $result  = array();

    foreach ( $autoload_map as $option_name => $autoload ) {
        $option_name = (string) $option_name;
        $desired[ $option_name ] = (bool) $autoload;
        $result[ $option_name ]  = false;
    }

    if ( empty( $desired ) ) {
        return $result;
    }

    $names        = array_keys( $desired );
    $placeholders = implode( ',', array_fill( 0, count( $names ), '%s' ) );

    $query = $wpdb->prepare(
        "SELECT option_name, autoload FROM {$wpdb->options} WHERE option_name IN ({$placeholders})",
        $names
    );

    $rows = $wpdb->get_results( $query, ARRAY_A );
    $existing = array();

    foreach ( $rows as $row ) {
        $existing[ (string) $row['option_name'] ] = (string) $row['autoload'];
    }

    $autoload_true = array( 'yes', 'on', 'auto-on', 'auto' );

    if ( function_exists( 'wp_autoload_values_to_autoload' ) ) {
        $autoload_true = wp_autoload_values_to_autoload();
    }

    $autoload_true = array_map( 'strtolower', array_map( 'strval', $autoload_true ) );
    $changed       = array();

    foreach ( $desired as $option_name => $wanted_autoload ) {
        if ( ! array_key_exists( $option_name, $existing ) ) {
            continue;
        }

        $current_autoload = strtolower( trim( (string) $existing[ $option_name ] ) );
        $is_autoloaded    = in_array( $current_autoload, $autoload_true, true );

        if ( $wanted_autoload !== $is_autoloaded ) {
            $changed[ $option_name ] = $wanted_autoload ? 'yes' : 'no';
            $result[ $option_name ]  = true;
        }
    }

    if ( ! empty( $changed ) ) {
        $cases  = array();
        $params = array();

        foreach ( $changed as $option_name => $new_autoload ) {
            $cases[]  = 'WHEN %s THEN %s';
            $params[] = $option_name;
            $params[] = $new_autoload;
        }

        $update_placeholders = implode( ',', array_fill( 0, count( $changed ), '%s' ) );

        $sql = "UPDATE {$wpdb->options}
                SET autoload = CASE option_name " . implode( ' ', $cases ) . " ELSE autoload END
                WHERE option_name IN ({$update_placeholders})";

        $params = array_merge( $params, array_keys( $changed ) );

        $wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare( $sql, $params ) );
    }

    return $result;
}

<?php
function wpbp_theme_templates_002( string $template_slug ): string {
    $template_slug = trim( $template_slug, "/ \t\n\r\0\x0B" );
    $template_slug = preg_replace( '/[^a-z0-9_\-]+/i', '-', $template_slug );
    $template_slug = preg_replace( '/-+/', '-', $template_slug );
    $template_slug = trim( $template_slug, '-' );

    if ( '' === $template_slug ) {
        $template_slug = 'index';
    }

    $hierarchy = array( $template_slug );

    $slug_parts = explode( '/', $template_slug );
    $slug       = array_pop( $slug_parts );

    if ( preg_match( '/^(category|tag|author|date|search|404|home|front-page|archive|single|page|attachment|singular|embed|comments|taxonomy)(?:-(.+))?$/', $slug, $matches ) ) {
        $type = $matches[1];
        $rest = isset( $matches[2] ) ? $matches[2] : '';

        if ( in_array( $type, array( 'category', 'tag', 'author', 'date' ), true ) ) {
            if ( '' !== $rest ) {
                $hierarchy[] = $type;
            }
            $hierarchy[] = 'archive';
        } elseif ( 'taxonomy' === $type ) {
            if ( '' !== $rest ) {
                $taxonomy_parts = explode( '-', $rest );
                if ( count( $taxonomy_parts ) > 1 ) {
                    $hierarchy[] = 'taxonomy-' . $taxonomy_parts[0];
                }
                $hierarchy[] = 'taxonomy';
            }
            $hierarchy[] = 'archive';
        } elseif ( 'single' === $type ) {
            if ( '' !== $rest ) {
                $single_parts = explode( '-', $rest );
                if ( count( $single_parts ) > 1 ) {
                    $hierarchy[] = 'single-' . $single_parts[0];
                }
                $hierarchy[] = 'single';
            }
            $hierarchy[] = 'singular';
        } elseif ( 'page' === $type ) {
            if ( '' !== $rest ) {
                $hierarchy[] = 'page';
            }
            $hierarchy[] = 'singular';
        } elseif ( 'attachment' === $type ) {
            if ( '' !== $rest ) {
                $hierarchy[] = 'attachment';
            }
            $hierarchy[] = 'single';
        } elseif ( 'archive' === $type ) {
            if ( '' !== $rest ) {
                $hierarchy[] = 'archive';
            }
        } elseif ( 'front-page' === $type ) {
            $hierarchy[] = 'home';
        }
    }

    $hierarchy = array_values( array_unique( $hierarchy ) );
    if ( ! in_array( 'index', $hierarchy, true ) ) {
        $hierarchy[] = 'index';
    }

    $available = array();

    if ( function_exists( 'get_block_templates' ) ) {
        $templates = get_block_templates( array( 'slug__in' => $hierarchy ), 'wp_template' );
        if ( is_array( $templates ) ) {
            foreach ( $templates as $template ) {
                if ( is_object( $template ) && isset( $template->slug ) ) {
                    $available[ $template->slug ] = true;
                } elseif ( is_string( $template ) ) {
                    $available[ $template ] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    foreach ( $hierarchy as $candidate ) {
        if ( isset( $available[ $candidate ] ) ) {
            return $candidate;
        }
    }

    if ( function_exists( 'get_block_template' ) && function_exists( 'get_stylesheet' ) ) {
        foreach ( $hierarchy as $candidate ) {
            $template = get_block_template( get_stylesheet() . '//' . $candidate, 'wp_template' );
            if ( is_object( $template ) && isset( $template->slug ) && $template->slug === $candidate ) {
                return $candidate;
            }
        }
    }

    return 'index';
}
